audit.why: Chart already reads Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Shen / Skill / Skill in both layers, which matches the packet stage read, the 52.4% win rate over 813 games, and the already-audited mirror. Difficulty 6/10 EVEN is right: the lane equalises once both sides are on tank items.
Level 3 full pattern, Stand United at 6, Sunfire/Heartsteel first item, and her Permafrost threat window at 4-5 are all correctly placed and correctly named.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six fields told you Spirit's Refuge blanks the damage Sejuani uses to build Frost stacks — whys[2] 'W-block her auto burst', whys[3] 'use W to nullify the auto-stacking', wants.you[1], dosFull[2] and phases[1].why. Winter's Wrath is a spell, and Riot's W text says it is what applies Frost stacks. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only, so it does not stop a single point of that. Separately, wants.foe[1] called Arctic Assault a slow.
audit.why: Riot's Shen W: 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — an attacks-only filter, no spell clause. Riot's Sejuani W: 'swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks' — the stacking source is a spell. Riot's Sejuani Q: 'charges forward, knocking enemies into the air' — a knockup, not a slow, and the kit carries no slow flag on Q.
audit.corrected: whys[2], whys[3], phases[1].why, wants.you[1], dosFull[2].t/.d and report[5].t now state that Spirit's Refuge blocks her autos but never Winter's Wrath, and that the real trade window is her W cooldown. wants.foe[1] now says Arctic Assault knocks you up mid-dash.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/W/E text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice on this page, and breakdown.cooldowns named Permafrost — a 1.5-second ability — as the cooldown to track.
audit.why: Permafrost is effectively always up; it is gated by Frost stacks, not by its own cooldown. The cooldown that actually gates her is Winter's Wrath at 9s falling to 5s, because it is the stack source.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with Winter's Wrath 9s->5s, Shadow Dash 18s at rank 1 / 14s at rank 3, and Stand United at 200s.
